title: FalseReject: A Resource for Improving Contextual Safety and Mitigating Over-Refusals in LLMs via Structured Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures over-refusal behavior on prompts related to 'Religion Promotion'. This is one of 44 safety-related categories designed to evaluate whether Large Language Models unnecessarily reject benign prompts that appear sensitive.
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to the 'Religion Promotion' category. The general findings, which apply across all 44 safety categories including religion, indicate that even state-of-the-art models struggle significantly with over-refusal, unnecessarily rejecting benign prompts. The study also found that fine-tuning models with the FalseReject dataset effectively reduces these refusals without compromising overall safety or general capabilities.
